translate.tip: Connect translate from first to last selected.
translate.what: Connects the checked translate axes of the first selected object into the last one.
steps: Select the driver first, the target last.
examples: Select the driver ctrl, then the target, check X and Y, click it.
Make a prop follow a ctrl translate only.
translate.details: connectAttr first.attr -> last.attr for each checked axis. Errors if the target attr is locked or already connected.

rotate.tip: Connect rotate from first to last selected.
rotate.what: Connects the checked rotate axes of the first selected object into the last one.
steps: Select the driver first, the target last.
examples: Make a wheel spin with a ctrl: select ctrl, then wheel, check X, click it.
Spin all wheels from one ctrl.
rotate.details: connectAttr first.attr -> last.attr for each checked axis. Errors if the target attr is locked or already connected.

scale.tip: Connect scale from first to last selected.
scale.what: Connects the checked scale axes of the first selected object into the last one.
steps: Select the driver first, the target last.
examples: Make a prop scale with its ctrl: select ctrl, then prop, click it.
Scale an accessory with a squash ctrl.
scale.details: connectAttr first.attr -> last.attr for each checked axis. Errors if the target attr is locked or already connected.

color_wheel.what: Opens Maya's color picker to choose a custom color for the selection.
examples: Pick the exact color the art director asked for.
Match the client color guide exactly.
color_wheel.details: cmds.colorEditor(), then assign_color_rgb with the picked color on each selected object.

red.what: Sets the override color of the selected controllers to red.
examples: Select the left side ctrls and click it so animators tell sides apart.
Color all the IK ctrls one color and FK another so the switch reads at a glance.
Use red for one rig part on every rig so animators learn the colors.
red.details: mt.assign_color(color): sets overrideEnabled + overrideColor (index color) on the shapes of the selected curves.

rgb_random.tip: One random color for the selection.
rgb_random.what: Gives all the selected controllers the same random color.
examples: Quickly tell a group of tweak ctrls apart.
Color a temp test set of ctrls.
rgb_random.details: One random RGB, assign_color_rgb on every selected object.

rgb_random_each.tip: A random color for each selected ctrl.
rgb_random_each.what: Gives every selected controller its own random color.
examples: Color each finger differently to check their order.
Check the order of many similar ctrls.
rgb_random_each.details: A new random RGB per selected object.

mutant_controller.tip: Turn the selection into Mutant controllers.
mutant_controller.what: Tags the selected curves (or every *_Ctrl if nothing is selected) as Mutant controllers: thicker lines, rotate order attr, saved on rebuild.
steps: Select your curves (or nothing for every *_Ctrl).
examples: Select ctrls you made by hand and click it so the rebuild keeps their shapes.
Make ctrls from another tool work with the Global ctrl visibility.
Tag ctrls you made in Rig Tools so rebuilds keep their shapes.
mutant_controller.details: Per ctrl: lineWidth 2, a RotateOrder attr connected to the rotate order (mt.connect_rotate_order), TagAsController, and <ctrl>_tag.visibilityMode driven by Global_Ctrl.CtrlVis.

mirror_behavior.what: Puts the selection in a group that mirrors it to the other side, like Maya mirror joint behavior.
examples: Select the left prop ctrl group, click it: the copy moves mirrored.
Mirror a left prop rig to the right.
mirror_behavior.details: mt.mirror_group(world=False): a parent group scaled -1 so local moves mirror, like joint mirror behavior.

world_mirror.tip: Mirror the selection in world space.
world_mirror.what: Puts the selection in a group that mirrors it across the world X axis.
examples: Mirror a ctrl so both sides move the same way in world.
Mirror a ctrl for world space movement like a foot.
world_mirror.details: mt.mirror_group(world=True): the -1 group mirrors in world space, so both sides move the same world direction.

root_auto.what: Adds a Root group and an Auto group above each selected ctrl, so you can drive it and still animate it.
steps: Connect or constrain the Auto group.
examples: Select a ctrl, click it, then connect drivers to the Auto group.
Drive a foot roll on the Auto group while animators still key the ctrl.
Add auto groups for a breathing system.
root_auto.details: mt.root_grp(autoRoot=True): <ctrl>_Root_Grp (keeps the rest pose) > <ctrl>_Auto_Grp (for drivers) > ctrl.

offset.what: Adds an offset group above each selected ctrl so its values are zero.
examples: Select a ctrl with values, click it: the ctrl reads 0 again.
Clean a ctrl that has values before giving it to animators.
offset.details: mt.root_grp(): an offset / root group that takes the ctrl transform, so the ctrl reads zero.

match.tip: Match transforms to the last selected.
match.what: Moves and rotates every selected object to the last selected one.
examples: Select the ctrl group, then the joint, click it to snap the ctrl to the joint.
Select several locators, then the joint: all of them snap to it.
Snap a locator to a joint to read its position.
match.details: parentConstraint from the last selected to each other one, deleted right away (position + rotation, no scale).
